posts.title: Julia 1.13 brings REPL improvements and more
posts.description: My article about the new stable release of Julia appeared today. Follow the link to read and to subscribe to LWN if for some odd reason you’re not already a subscriber.

posts.title: Goodbye from Salon
posts.description: Forgive me for speaking ill of the dead, but I can’t resist quoting Sam Harris, talking to the people at Salon: “There’s a real confusion about what journalism has become, and I can assure you that very few people realize that much of what appears on your website is produced by malicious freaks who are just blogging in their underpants.”
